about: Keyboard + mouse and the wide screen (Dom 2026-10-28: 'keyboard + mouse input and a 16:9 landscape layout, Steam needs it'; src/fight/kbm.ts validateInput checks the values, src/fight/input.ts reads `keys`/`mouse`). INPUT and PRESENTATION only: the duel sim, the digest and Gate 0 never see this file. Row shapes follow ARMAGEDOM Web/src/data/inputKeys.json (PR #450): schema_version, `keys` = action -> KeyboardEvent.code list, mouse buttons by name (`mouseButtons`, `mouse`), `keyNames`/`mouseNames`/`hints` rows the footer legend is built from (kbm.ts legendFor). Where V3 differs it keeps its own shipped keys (F strike, G heavy, T stab, Q guard, E roll) because V3 players already have them. `on`/`query`/`off`: ?input=v1 turns every new binding, the detection, the hiding and the wide layout off (the controls exactly as they were; the same flag as respawn.json input, which keeps the stick through a hand-over). `detect`: the page marks <html data-kbm> when a keyboard or mouse is in use (`media` matches at load, a mapped key or a mouse that moved `mouseMovePx` turns it on, a touch or a pen press turns it off again); `hide` lists the touch controls not drawn while data-kbm is set (the SPECIAL buttons stay: they carry the ready ring). `keys`: action -> codes. Movement is W A S D plus the arrow keys (arrows also pick the guard side with Q held and are fixed). Tab toggles the soft lock (let go: the camera is yours; Tab again locks on). Esc drops every held key and press. `mouse`: primary (left) is STRIKE (see `strike`), secondary (right) held is GUARD (slide the cursor `strike.slidePx` for the side). No pointer lock: the cursor stays visible so a click on a cut part still takes it (data/pickup.json) and a click on another boss still switches the lock. Look: while the camera is free (before an aggro, after a kill, or after Tab) a left-drag past `lookDragPx` looks round (the phone's look thumb, respawn.json look); a click without a drag is a strike. In a locked fight the camera is the pair camera and the mouse movement picks the swing. `strike`: the STRIKE thumb's mapping: a plain click is the light (alternating), A or D (or the arrows) held is that side's slash, W held (`forwardStab`) is the stab, a flick of `slidePx` while the button is down is the stab (up) or that side's slash (left/right), held past the heavy hold it is the heavy (flick up = heavy stab). `layout`: the screen shapes (<html data-layout>): the first row whose `minAspect`, `maxAspect`, `minHeight` and `maxHeight` all hold wins; portrait is exactly the layout that shipped (no mark, no rule). <html data-wide> is set when the aspect is at least `wideAspect`.

hints.text: strike (A/D slash, W stab, hold = heavy)
